description: This file contains utility functions and classes for handling Azure Blob Storage operations, including gzipping, gunzipping, flattening test suite specifications, and managing blob uploads/downloads within a testing dashboard context.

classes.name: SimpleBlob
classes.description: A class for managing Azure Blob Storage blobs, including creating, downloading, and uploading gzipped JSON data.

methods.name: flattenSpecs
methods.description: Recursively flattens a test suite object into a list of specs with their title paths.

methods.name: SimpleBlob.create
methods.description: Creates an instance of SimpleBlob for a specific container and blob name.

methods.name: SimpleBlob.download
methods.description: Downloads the blob content, decompresses if gzipped, and parses JSON.

methods.name: SimpleBlob.uploadGzipped
methods.description: Uploads JSON data as a gzipped blob with appropriate headers.

methods.name: deleteBlob
methods.description: Deletes a specified blob from a container.
